sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and currently sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 matches. They face Alsager Town, who are struggling near the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their title challenge.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough test away at Dawley Town, with the visitors level on recent form (most recent game a draw) and looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in a meeting of mid-table sides, with Eccleshall having mixed recent form (one loss, one win) and Bridgnorth seeking to bounce back from their sole recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals host bottom-dwellers Widnes Town—the visitors have only 2 points and are winless in seven games, making this a golden chance for Casuals to climb further. Bilston Town (6th) take on Foley Meir (13th) in a fixture between sides separated by three league positions, while Barnton host struggling Shawbury United, who have lost their last four games. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a match between two mid-table sides, both seeking consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a relegation-zone clash involving two of the league's lowest scorers. Brereton Social host Widnes Town... actually, the fixture list shows Brereton Social v Widnes Town at home for Brereton. Finally, Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a fixture between two sides in the lower half, with Crewe on a poor run and Allscott Heath showing signs of recovery.
